name: Nera – Strike A Win
author: Nera
upgrade_notice: Update to the latest release for bug fixes and improvements.

sections.description:
Skill-based prize-competition quiz mechanic: paid entry, a timed increasing-difficulty quiz, and earned Lottery for WooCommerce tickets entered into the competition draw. Server-scored with a no-oversell reservation pool, compliance-locked for the Gambling Act 2005 skill exemption.

Requires WooCommerce (and Lottery for WooCommerce for ticket minting).
sections.installation: Install and activate WooCommerce and Lottery for WooCommerce, then install and activate this plugin. Configure competitions and tiers, then enable the frontend UI from the plugin's admin controls.
